feature_brief.title: 802 — Normalize Text
feature_brief.outcome: One local file yields normalized text or an evidenced deterministic error.
scope_in: Python standard-library CLI and function for exactly one local UTF-8 text file
Per-line ASCII space/tab edge trimming; interior whitespace, Unicode and logical blank lines preserved
CRLF and bare CR become LF; empty input yields empty output; nonempty input gains a final LF only when normalized output lacks it; existing trailing LF preserved
stdout output without file writes; missing files/directories/invalid UTF-8 exit 2 with stderr and no stdout
No size limit; Python unittest covers rules and errors
